data.content: Implementation is complete locally on branch worktree-knots-5271-event-log-compaction at commits f0063a311039 and 3cd62f5a96fc. Added the measured design report, deterministic 80k fixture/inventory tools, 10-case executable protocol oracle, documentation indexes, and task records. make sanity passed with 95.21% coverage; the 80k run measured 80,000 files, 18,197,788 bytes, 533.977 ms median scan, and 1,581.668 ms median no-op sync model. Shipment is blocked because origin is GitHub, which repository instructions prohibit, and the authenticated Diffinite account has no knots repository or configured remote. No branch was published.
